query_text: What medicine should I take when I get a cold?

content.text:
I can answer this based on my existing knowledge — no search needed. Here is some general guidance on medicines commonly used to manage cold symptoms:

> ⚠️ **Disclaimer:** This is general informational guidance only and **not a substitute for professional medical advice**. Always consult a doctor or pharmacist before taking any medication, especially if you have underlying health conditions or are taking other medicines.

---

## 💊 Common Medicines for Cold Symptoms

Colds are caused by viruses, so **antibiotics won't help**. Treatment focuses on **relieving symptoms**:

### 1. 🤧 Nasal Congestion
- **Decongestants** (e.g., **Pseudoephedrine**, **Phenylephrine**) — help relieve a stuffy nose.
- **Nasal saline sprays** — a gentle, drug-free option to clear nasal passages.

### 2. 😤 Runny Nose & Sneezing
- **Antihistamines** (e.g., **Diphenhydramine**, **Loratadine**, **Chlorpheniramine**) — can help dry up a runny nose and reduce sneezing.

### 3. 🤒 Fever & Pain (Sore Throat, Headache, Body Aches)
- **Acetaminophen (Paracetamol/Tylenol)** — reduces fever and relieves pain. Generally very safe when used as directed.
- **Ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin)** — an anti-inflammatory that also reduces fever and pain.
- **Aspirin** — effective for adults, but **should NOT be given to children** due to the risk of Reye's syndrome.

### 4. 😮 Cough
- **Dextromethorphan (DXM)** — a cough suppressant for dry coughs.
- **Guaifenesin (Mucinex)** — an expectorant that helps loosen mucus for productive coughs.

### 5. 🌿 All-in-One Cold Medicines
- Products like **DayQuil**, **NyQuil**, or **Theraflu** combine several of the above ingredients to treat multiple symptoms at once.

---

## 🏠 Non-Medicine Remedies That Also Help
- **Rest** — your body needs energy to fight the virus.
- **Stay hydrated** — water, heroth, and warm teas soothe the throat and prevent dehydration.
- **Honey & lemon** — can soothe a sore throat (do not give honey to children under 1 year old).
- **Steam inhalation or humidifier** — helps relieve congestion.
- **Zinc & Vitamin C** — some studies suggest they may reduce cold duration if taken early.

---

## 🚨 When to See a Doctor
See a doctor if you experience:
- High fever (above 103°F / 39.4°C)
- Symptoms lasting **more than 10 days**
- Severe chest pain or difficulty breathing
- Symptoms that improve then suddenly worsen

Again, always consult a **healthcare professional or pharmacist** for personalized advice. Feel better soon! 🍵
